guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 鋼構辦公、預力混凝土飯店住宅與鋼構塔頂的混合分區，以及由上而下的核心筒施工。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Mixed zoning of steel offices, post-tensioned concrete hotel and homes and a steel crown, built with a top-down core. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.
facts: 官方高度 309.6 m、共 95 層，最高可居住樓層為第 72 層；CTBUH 資料庫列建築高度 306 m
觀景台位於 68 至 72 層，高約 244 m
設計在 50 年回歸期風況下擺動約 300 至 400 mm
鑽掘樁直徑 1,500 mm、深約 50 m，周邊咬合樁直徑 900 mm，筏基厚 1.5 至 3 m
上部柱混凝土約 65 至 80 MPa，樓板約 50 至 60 MPa
後拉預力平板厚 200 mm、跨度約 9 m；辦公層跨度可達約 15 m
塔頂尖塔高 66 m、約 500 公噸，由約 800 件玻璃與鋼構件組成
周邊柱距以費氏格框由 6 m 加密到 3 m 再到 1.5 m
factsEn: Official height 309.6 m with 95 storeys and level 72 the highest habitable floor; the CTBUH database lists 306 m
Viewing gallery on levels 68 to 72, about 244 m high
Designed to sway about 300 to 400 mm in winds expected once in 50 years
Bored piles 1,500 mm in diameter and about 50 m deep, 900 mm secant perimeter piles and a 1.5 to 3 m raft
Upper-level column concrete about 65 to 80 MPa and slabs about 50 to 60 MPa
Post-tensioned slabs 200 mm thick spanning about 9 m; office spans reach about 15 m
The 66 m spire weighs about 500 t and comprises about 800 glass and steel pieces
About 11,000 glass panels on the façade
Vierendeel grids step perimeter column spacing from 6 m to 3 m to 1.5 m
timeline: 2009　3 月全面動工，展開由上而下的地下室與核心筒施工
2011　年初核心筒升到約第 72 層，上部預力樓板持續施作
2012　3 月 66 m 尖塔就位，7 月舉行落成儀式
2013　2 月觀景台開放，CTBUH 記錄的完工年份
timelineEn: 2009 — Full construction begins in March with top-down basement and core works
2011 — Early in the year the core reaches about level 72 as upper post-tensioned floors continue
2012 — The 66 m spire is set in March and the building is inaugurated in July
2013 — The viewing gallery opens in February, the completion year recorded by CTBUH
codes: Concrete Society TR43：後拉預力混凝土樓板
codesEn: EN 1991-1-4: Actions on structures – Wind actions
EN 1992-1-1: Design of concrete structures – General rules
EN 1993-1-2: Design of steel structures – Structural fire design
Concrete Society TR43: Post-tensioned concrete floors
landmarks: 倫敦聖瑪莉艾克斯 30 號
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：碎片大廈
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: The Shard
guides.concept: 碎片大廈由 Renzo Piano 設計、WSP 擔任結構設計、Mace 承建，官方高度 309.6 m、共 95 層。結構依用途分區：下部辦公層為複合鋼構，上部飯店與住宅層為 200 mm 後拉預力混凝土平板，塔頂以鋼構「散熱器」與桅桿收尾；中央混凝土核心筒是主要抗側骨幹，以費氏桁架與 A 形轉換調整柱距。英國首次採用由上而下的核心筒施工，讓核心筒在地下室開挖時同步上升。本課涵蓋分區質量、扭轉、預力樓板、轉換構件、由上而下施工、尖塔與塔吊、風洞、鄰近鐵路監測、帷幕牆與帽桁架的交接。
guides.conceptEn: The Shard, designed by Renzo Piano with WSP as structural designer and Mace as contractor, is officially 309.6 m tall with 95 storeys. Its structure is zoned by use: composite steel for the lower offices, 200 mm post-tensioned concrete flat slabs for the hotel and homes above, and a steel radiator and mast at the crown; a central concrete core is the main lateral spine, with Vierendeel trusses and A-frames changing column spacing. It was the first UK use of top-down core construction, letting the core rise while the basement was being dug. The course covers zoned mass, torsion, post-tensioned slabs, transfer structures, top-down construction, spire and cranes, wind-tunnel testing, monitoring of adjacent rail assets, curtain-wall joints and the handover of hat trusses.
procedure: 設計者公開說明：下部辦公與零售層採複合鋼構，周邊到混凝土核心筒的跨度可達約 15 m，樓板梁為約 500 mm 深的組合斷面；上部飯店與住宅層改用 200 mm 厚後拉預力混凝土平板，跨度約 9 m、層高約 3.1 m；塔頂約 60 m 為鋼構「散熱器」，容納散熱設備並圍繞中央斜撐鋼桅。上部較重的混凝土樓板增加了高處的模態質量與阻尼，設計者因此認為不需要另設補充阻尼裝置。
中央混凝土核心筒剪力牆是主要的抗側骨幹，飯店與住宅層另加翼牆提高核心勁度；頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性。塔樓低層一側附有被稱為「背包」的低層附屬量體，其中設有次核心，用來減少主核心承受的扭轉。當風力合力或質量中心與剛心不重合時，樓層會繞剛心旋轉，角落位移比中心大；在偏心側增加剪力牆，相當於增大扭轉勁度並拉近剛心與質心。
上部飯店與住宅層的柱使用約 65 至 80 MPa 高強混凝土，樓板為 50 至 60 MPa 的後拉預力平板。後拉鋼腱以拋物線佈置，在跨中靠下、在柱上靠上，張拉後對混凝土產生向上的等效荷重，抵銷大部分自重；薄板因此能以約 9 m 跨度、200 mm 厚度控制撓度與裂縫，縮小層高並在塔頂收分時節省高度。柱斷面因高強度而縮小，讓逐層收縮的平面仍保有可用面積。

不同用途要求不同柱距：辦公需要開闊空間，住宅與飯店則以房間模組配置柱位。設計者以鋼構費氏桁架把上部柱重新對位到辦公層，並以費氏格框把周邊柱距由 6 m 逐步加密到 3 m 再到 1.5 m；在與背包量體交接處則用 A 形轉換構架加大下方柱距。核心內另有轉換牆與轉換梁支撐半高處的空中大廳。重新對位的傾斜周邊柱會在樓板隔板產生推拉水平力，最後由核心筒平衡。費氏桁架沒有斜桿，靠弦桿與豎桿的剛接彎矩傳遞剪力。

主塔地下室採由上而下施工：先施作周邊直徑 900 mm 的咬合樁擋土牆與直徑 1,500 mm、深約 50 m 的鑽掘樁，在樁中插入鋼柱（插入柱），再由地面向下逐層施作樓板並開挖，樓板同時作為擋土牆的水平支撐。核心筒則在地下室尚未完成時就開始向上施作，地上與地下同時推進。這縮短工期並限制鄰近地層位移，但在筏基完成前，核心筒與已完成樓層的荷重全靠插入柱與樁承擔，因此可以先蓋多高是一個明確的計算問題。
公開資料指出工程共使用五部塔吊，其中四部隨塔樓「跳升」，並有英國首部架在滑模頂上的塔吊；塔頂 66 m、約 500 公噸的尖塔由約 800 件玻璃與鋼構件組成，最後一部塔吊專為安裝上部尖塔而架設。爬升塔吊把垂直荷重與傾覆力矩透過兩道以上的支承框傳給核心牆，因此核心牆在支承位置的混凝土齡期、強度與局部承壓都要檢核；塔樓收分到頂部時空間狹小，尖塔構件的分段重量與吊裝順序決定了塔吊選型。
設計團隊以三維有限元素與動力分析求出頻率與振型，並委託 RWDI 做高頻力平衡（HFFB）風洞試驗，估算風致加速度以檢核居住舒適度；另以補充試驗設計塔頂散熱器與帷幕牆桁架。官方資料指出大樓設計在 50 年回歸期風況下擺動約 300 至 400 mm。住宅與飯店的舒適度要求比辦公嚴格，因為人在家中與夜間對擺動較敏感，所以上部住宅層的加速度是控制條件之一。
大樓緊鄰倫敦橋車站與地下鐵設施，基地上還留有舊建築的樁與擴底。設計者以有限元素分析預測開挖對鄰近基礎設施的位移在可接受範圍，並規劃施工期監測；新樁盡量布置在既有樁與擴底之間。由上而下施工讓樓板在開挖時即提供剛性支撐，減少擋土牆變形與背後地表沉陷。監測的目的是在位移發展到影響軌道、隧道或車站結構前提出警訊，讓施工方法能及時調整。
官方資料指出外牆約有 11,000 片玻璃，傾斜的玻璃「碎片」在塔頂延伸並以 25 mm 拉桿斜撐的垂直桁架穩定。帷幕牆單元必須同時容納多種位移：層間變位造成的面內錯動、鋁框溫度伸縮、樓板邊緣撓度與柱的長期縮短。接縫若只按其中一項設計，在其他位移疊加時會被擠壓或拉開，密封膠疲勞後漏水漏氣。傾斜立面使雨水與日照條件更嚴苛，接縫的耐久與可更換性更為重要。
設計者說明頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性，因為它們不是強度所需的構件，所以未做防火被覆。這是一個需要被記錄的工程判斷：火災時鋼材高溫後勁度下降，帽桁架對側向勁度的貢獻減少，但結構強度仍由核心筒保證。若未來有人不知道這個前提，可能把帽桁架當成承載構件加以利用（例如懸吊設備或改造時依賴其強度），就會破壞原本的防火策略。
procedureEn: The designers explain that the lower office and retail floors are composite steel with spans of up to about 15 m from the perimeter to the concrete core and built-up floor beams about 500 mm deep; the hotel and residential floors above switch to 200 mm post-tensioned concrete flat slabs spanning about 9 m with a storey height of about 3.1 m; the top 60 m or so is a steel radiator housing heat-rejection plant around a central braced steel mast. The heavier concrete floors high up add modal mass and damping, which the designers considered sufficient to avoid supplementary damping devices.

The central concrete core shear walls are the main lateral spine, with wing walls added at hotel and residential levels to stiffen the core, and outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability. A low-rise annex called the Backpack attaches to one side at the lower levels, and its secondary core reduces torsion on the main core. When the wind resultant or centre of mass does not coincide with the centre of stiffness, floors rotate about the stiffness centre and corners move more than the middle; adding shear walls on the eccentric side raises torsional stiffness and draws the centres together.

Columns in the upper hotel and residential levels use about 65 to 80 MPa high-strength concrete, and floors are 50 to 60 MPa post-tensioned flat slabs. Tendons follow a parabolic profile, low at mid-span and high over columns, so after stressing they apply an upward equivalent load that cancels most of the self-weight; the thin slab can therefore span about 9 m at 200 mm thick while controlling deflection and cracking, reducing storey height and saving height as the tower tapers. High strength keeps column sections small so the shrinking floor plates retain usable area.

Different uses need different column spacing: offices want open space while homes and hotels align columns with room modules. The designers used steel Vierendeel trusses to realign upper columns onto the office floors, and Vierendeel grids to step perimeter column spacing from 6 m to 3 m to 1.5 m; at the junction with the Backpack, A-frame transfers widen the spacing below. Inside the core, transfer walls and girders support the mid-height sky lobby. Inclined perimeter columns that realign create push–pull forces in the floor diaphragms, finally resolved by the core. A Vierendeel truss has no diagonals and carries shear through bending in rigidly connected chords and verticals.

The main tower basement was built top-down: first a perimeter secant-pile wall of 900 mm piles and 1,500 mm bored piles about 50 m deep were installed, with steel plunge columns set into the piles; then slabs were cast level by level downward as excavation proceeded, each slab propping the retaining wall. The core started rising before the basement was finished, so work advanced above and below ground at once. This shortens the programme and limits ground movement, but until the raft is complete the core and finished floors rely entirely on the plunge columns and piles, so how high the core may go first is an explicit calculation.

Public sources say five tower cranes were used, four of which jumped with the tower, including the first UK crane supported on top of a slipform; the 66 m, roughly 500 t spire at the top consists of about 800 pieces of glass and steel, and a final crane was erected specifically to install its upper part. A climbing crane transfers vertical load and overturning moment to the core walls through two or more support collars, so concrete age, strength and local bearing at the collar locations must be checked; as the tower tapers to the top, space becomes tight and the weight and sequence of spire pieces drive crane selection.

The design team derived frequencies and mode shapes with three-dimensional finite-element and dynamic analysis and commissioned RWDI to run high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) wind-tunnel tests estimating wind-induced acceleration for occupant comfort; further tests informed the design of the crown radiator and cladding trusses. Official sources state the building is designed to sway about 300 to 400 mm in winds expected once every 50 years. Comfort criteria for homes and hotels are stricter than for offices because people at home and at night are more sensitive to motion, so accelerations at the upper residential floors are one of the controlling conditions.

The building sits beside London Bridge station and Underground assets, and old piles and under-reams remained on the site. The designers used finite-element analysis to predict that movements of adjacent infrastructure would stay within acceptable limits and planned monitoring during construction, and new piles were placed between existing piles and under-reams where possible. Top-down construction lets slabs prop the wall stiffly during excavation, reducing wall deflection and ground settlement behind it. Monitoring exists to warn before movements affect tracks, tunnels or station structures, so methods can be adjusted in time.

Official sources state the façade has about 11,000 glass panels, and the tilted glass shards extending above the roof are stabilised by vertical trusses braced with 25 mm rods. Curtain-wall units must accommodate several movements at once: in-plane racking from storey drift, thermal movement of aluminium frames, slab-edge deflection and long-term column shortening. A joint designed for only one of these is crushed or opened when the others add up, and the sealant fatigues until water and air leak. Inclined façades make rain and sun exposure harsher, so joint durability and replaceability matter even more.

The designers explain that the outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability and, because they are not required for strength, were not fire-protected. That is an engineering judgement that must be documented: in a fire, heated steel loses stiffness and the hat trusses contribute less lateral stiffness, while strength is still assured by the core. If future users are unaware of this premise and start relying on the hat trusses, for example to hang equipment or as strength members in a renovation, the original fire strategy is undermined.
evidence: 設計基準應記錄各分區的樓板質量假設與其對加速度的影響，日後若變更用途（例如住宅改辦公）或大幅減輕裝修，須由結構工程師評估居住性。
對有附屬量體或不對稱收分的塔樓，設計報告應逐層列出偏心距與扭轉不規則判定，並說明次核心或翼牆的配置理由；施工中次核心與主核心的連接樓板須按順序完成。
預力樓板竣工圖必須標示鋼腱位置與禁鑽區，物業管理規章規定任何鑽孔須先以掃描定位並經結構工程師核可；張拉屬高風險作業，須由合格專業廠商依核准程序執行。
轉換構件應列為關鍵構件，施工圖標示預拱、臨時支撐與允許拆撐的條件；轉換層樓板的開孔與日後改裝須經結構工程師審查。
由上而下施工須在設計階段就訂出「筏基完成前核心允許高度」與樓板拆撐順序，列為合約中的停留點；插入柱驗收與每階段開挖前的支撐確認都要有結構與大地工程師簽認。
evidenceEn: The design basis should record the floor-mass assumption of each zone and its effect on acceleration, and any later change of use, such as residential to office, or major lightening of finishes requires the structural engineer to reassess habitability.

For towers with annexes or asymmetric tapering, the design report should list eccentricity and torsional-irregularity checks floor by floor and justify the secondary core or wing walls; floors linking secondary and main cores must be completed in the planned sequence.

As-built drawings of post-tensioned slabs must show tendon locations and no-drill zones, building rules must require scanning and structural approval before any drilling, and stressing, a high-risk operation, must be done by a qualified specialist under an approved procedure.

Treat transfer members as key elements, showing camber, temporary shoring and conditions for removing it on the drawings, and require structural review for openings and later alterations in transfer-level slabs.

Top-down construction needs a design-stage limit on core height before raft completion and a slab-prop removal sequence, written into the contract as hold points; plunge-column acceptance and prop confirmation before each excavation stage require sign-off by structural and geotechnical engineers.
pitfalls: 若上部改用較輕的樓板或大幅減少隔間與裝修質量而未重新評估，高處加速度可能上升到住宅與飯店的舒適度門檻以上；不同樓板系統的交界層若勁度與質量突變未處理，也容易出現樓板裂縫。
日後在預力板上鑽孔或切割若打斷鋼腱，會突然失去預力，造成局部撓度增加，甚至鋼腱彈出的危險；張拉時混凝土強度不足則可能使錨定區爆裂。
插入柱若偏斜超出允差，後續包覆與樓板接合困難並產生附加彎矩；若核心上升超過樁的承載能力而筏基延誤，樁頭沉陷會使核心傾斜，連帶影響後續所有樓層的垂直度。
若結構頻率或阻尼與風洞假設不符（例如混凝土實際模數較低），實際加速度可能高於預測，住戶在強風夜晚感到不適，而事後加裝阻尼器在已完工的高價住宅層中極為困難。
接縫寬度不足時，強風或夏季高溫下單元互相擠壓使玻璃邊緣受力破裂；密封膠老化後雨水沿傾斜立面滲入，造成室內漏水與錨件腐蝕。
pitfallsEn: Switching upper floors to lighter construction or greatly reducing partitions and finishes without re-evaluation can raise upper-level accelerations above residential and hotel comfort limits; abrupt stiffness and mass changes at the interface between floor systems also invite slab cracking if not addressed.

Drilling or cutting a post-tensioned slab later and severing a tendon causes a sudden loss of prestress, extra local deflection and even the danger of a tendon ejecting; stressing before the concrete is strong enough can burst the anchorage zone.

Plunge columns installed out of tolerance are hard to encase and connect to slabs and attract extra moments; if the core outruns the piles' capacity while the raft is delayed, pile settlement tilts the core and affects the verticality of every later storey.

If structural frequency or damping differs from the wind-tunnel assumption, for example because the real concrete modulus is lower, actual acceleration can exceed predictions and residents feel unwell on windy nights, while retrofitting a damper into finished high-value residential floors is extremely difficult.

Joints that are too narrow let units press against each other in high wind or summer heat until glass edges crack; aged sealant lets rain run into the inclined façade, causing interior leaks and corrosion of anchors.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 建築施工階段結構分析
related.transfer: 可遷移「混合用途分區與樓板系統」與「風洞試驗與居住舒適度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；建築施工階段結構分析的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems" and "Wind-tunnel testing and occupant comfort" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Construction-stage structural analysis must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦鋼構辦公、預力混凝土飯店住宅與鋼構塔頂的混合分區，以及由上而下的核心筒施工；建築施工階段結構分析則以依真實施工順序逐步啟動構件、荷重與材料齡期，找出臨時狀態的控制內力、變形與接合時機為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on mixed zoning of steel offices, post-tensioned concrete hotel and homes and a steel crown, built with a top-down core; Construction-stage structural analysis centres on activating members, loads and material age in the real construction order to find governing forces, deformations and connection timing in temporary states, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「用途分區與樓板質量」與「一次加載與逐層加載」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到建築施工階段結構分析，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「施工測量的溫度效應修正」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Use zoning and floor mass” and “One-step versus staged loading”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Construction-stage structural analysis, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Temperature correction of construction surveys", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 碎片大廈
history.text: 碎片大廈由開發商 Irvine Sellar 推動，Renzo Piano Building Workshop 設計建築，WSP 擔任結構設計，Robert Bird Group 參與結構工程，Mace 承建。2009 年全面動工，英國首次以由上而下的方式施作核心筒，讓核心筒在地下室開挖的同時向上升；2012 年 3 月 66 m 的尖塔吊裝就位，7 月舉行落成儀式，觀景台於 2013 年 2 月開放。結構上的新意在於依用途垂直分區：下部鋼構辦公、上部後拉預力混凝土飯店與住宅、塔頂鋼構散熱器，並以轉換構件調和不同柱距，以上部混凝土樓板的質量取代補充阻尼裝置。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The Shard was promoted by developer Irvine Sellar, designed by Renzo Piano Building Workshop with WSP as structural designer, Robert Bird Group contributing structural engineering and Mace as contractor. Full construction began in 2009 with the UK's first top-down core, rising while the basement was excavated; the 66 m spire was lifted into place in March 2012, the building was inaugurated in July and the viewing gallery opened in February 2013. Its structural novelty is vertical zoning by use: steel offices below, post-tensioned concrete hotel and homes above and a steel radiator at the crown, with transfer structures reconciling different column grids and the mass of the upper concrete floors standing in for supplementary dampers. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.text: 2 月觀景台開放，CTBUH 記錄的完工年份
history.textEn: The viewing gallery opens in February, the completion year recorded by CTBUH

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「混合用途分區與樓板系統」到「使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems" through "Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
